title: Negotiating politely
explanation: Good negotiators separate the person from the problem. Use conditional language to make offers without sounding aggressive: "If you could increase the order, we would be able to reduce the price." To disagree politely, say "I see your point, but…" or "I understand, however…". Ask questions to learn the other side's priorities, and summarise any agreement before you finish.
examples: conditional: describing what would happen if something else happened
priority: something more important than other things
I see your point, but…: a polite way to disagree

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most polite way to disagree?
options: I see your point, but we have a different budget.
exercises.explain: It acknowledges the other view first.
exercises.promptSo: Weedhee ayaa ah habka ugu edebta badan ee lagu muujiyo diidmo?
exercises.explainSo: Waxay marka hore aqoonsanaysaa aragtida qofka kale.
optionsSo: Waan fahmay aragtidaada, laakiin miisaaniyaddeennu way ka duwan tahay.

options: If you could increase the order, we would be able to reduce the price.
exercises.explain: "If you could… we would be able to…" is conditional.
exercises.promptSo: Soo jeedimee ayaa adeegsanaysa qaab shuruudaysan?
exercises.explainSo: Qaabka “If you could... we would be able to...” waa qaab shuruudaysan.
optionsSo: Haddii aad kordhin karto dalabka, waxaan awoodi karnaa inaan qiimaha dhimno.

exercises.promptSo: Isku hagaaji erayada si ay jumlad u noqdaan.
exercises.explainSo: Waa tusaale muujinaya khilaaf si edeb leh loo cabbiray.

titleSo: Wada-xaajood xirfad leh oo edeb ku dhisan
explanationSo: Qofka wada-xaajoodka wanaagsan sameeya wuxuu kala saaraa qofka iyo dhibaatada laga hadlayo. Adeegso qaab shuruudaysan si aad dalab u soo jeediso adigoon u muuqan qof gardarro badan: “Haddii aad kordhin karto tirada dalabka, waxaan awoodi karnaa inaan qiimaha dhimno.” Si edeb leh u diid adigoo leh “Waan fahmay aragtidaada, laakiin...” ama “Waan fahamsanahay, hase yeeshee...”. Su’aalo weydii si aad u ogaato waxyaabaha dhinaca kale mudnaanta siinayo, dabadeedna soo koob heshiiska ka hor intaadan dhamayn.
examplesSo: Shuruudaysan: sharxaya waxa dhici lahaa haddii arrin kale dhacdo.
Mudnaan: arrin ka muhiimsan arrimaha kale.
“Waan fahmay aragtidaada, laakiin...” — hab edeb leh oo lagu muujiyo diidmo ama aragti ka duwan.

title: Handling questions after a presentation
explanation: Treat every question as useful feedback. Paraphrase it first ("If I understand correctly, you are asking whether…") to check your understanding and give yourself time to think. If you do not know the answer, say so honestly and offer to follow up: "That is a fair question; I don't have the figures to hand, but I will get back to you by Thursday." Avoid defensive language and keep answers concise.
examples: paraphrase: to say something again in different words
defensive: behaving as if you are being attacked

exercises.prompt: Why paraphrase a question before answering?
options: To check understanding and gain thinking time
exercises.explain: It confirms meaning and gives you time.
exercises.promptSo: Maxaa su’aasha erayo kale loogu celiyaa ka hor jawaabta?
exercises.explainSo: Waxay xaqiijinaysaa macnaha su’aasha, waxayna ku siinaysaa waqti aad ku fikirto.
optionsSo: Si loo hubiyo fahamka loona helo waqti fikir

exercises.prompt: Which response is best if you do not know the answer?
options: That is a fair question; I will get back to you by Thursday.
exercises.explain: It is honest and offers a follow-up.
exercises.promptSo: Jawaabtee ayaa ugu habboon haddii aadan jawaabta garanayn?
exercises.explainSo: Waa daacad, waxayna bixisaa ballanqaad dabagal ah.
optionsSo: Waa su’aal wanaagsan; Khamiista ayaan kuu soo jawaabi doonaa.

exercises.prompt: Avoid ... language, which sounds as if you are being attacked. (one word)
exercises.promptSo: Buuxi: Ka fogow luqad ... ah, taas oo muujinaysa inaad is leedahay waa lagu weeraray. (hal eray)
exercises.explainSo: Luqadda is-difaaca badan waa in laga fogaadaa.

titleSo: Ka jawaabista su’aalaha bandhigga ka dib
explanationSo: Su’aal kasta u arag jawaab-celin waxtar leh. Marka hore su’aasha erayo kale ku celi (“Haddii aan si sax ah kuu fahmay, waxaad weydiinaysaa in...”) si aad u hubiso inaad fahantay, isla markaana aad waqti ugu hesho fikirka. Haddii aadan jawaabta garanayn, si daacad ah u sheeg oo ballanqaad inaad xogta dib ula soo noqon doonto: “Waa su’aal wanaagsan; hadda tirooyinka gacanta kuma hayo, laakiin Khamiista ayaan kuu soo jawaabi doonaa.” Ka fogow hadal is-difaac ah, jawaabtana koobi.
examplesSo: Si kale u sheeg: in fikrad isla macne ah erayo kale lagu cabbiro.
Gacanta ku haysa: hadda diyaar kuu ah ama aad heli karto.
Is-difaac badan: u dhaqmid sidii qof lagu weeraray ama lagu eedaynayo.

title: Follow-up emails
explanation: A follow-up email should be short and specific. Start with the reference: "Following our meeting on Tuesday,…". State what you need and give a date: "Could you send the signed contract by Friday?". If you have not had a reply, use a polite reminder: "I'm writing to follow up on my previous email." Close with a clear next step and "Kind regards".
examples: following…: used to refer to something that happened earlier
reminder: something that helps you remember
next step: the action that should happen next

exercises.prompt: Which opening refers clearly to a previous event?
exercises.explain: It names the event and day.
exercises.promptSo: Furitaankee ayaa si cad u tilmaamaya dhacdo hore?
exercises.explainSo: Waxay magacaabaysaa dhacdada iyo maalintii ay dhacday.

options: Could you send the signed contract by Friday?
Why have you not sent it?
exercises.explain: It is polite, specific and gives a deadline.
exercises.explainSo: Waa codsi edeb leh, gaar ah, wuxuuna leeyahay waqti kama dambays ah.
optionsSo: Ma ii soo diri kartaa heshiiska saxeexan ugu dambayn Jimcaha?

exercises.promptSo: Buuxi: Xiritaan edeb leh waa “Kind ...”. (hal eray)
exercises.explainSo: “Kind regards” waa xiritaan iimayl oo caadi ah.

explanationSo: Iimayl dabagal ahi waa inuu noqdaa mid kooban oo si cad u sheegaya arrinta. Ku bilow tixraaca dhacdadii hore: “Anigoo tixraacaya kulankeennii Talaadadii...”. Sheeg waxa aad u baahan tahay, kuna dar taariikh cayiman: “Ma ii soo diri kartaa heshiiska saxeexan ugu dambayn Jimcaha?”. Haddii aan laguu soo jawaabin, si edeb leh u xusuusi: “Waxaan idiin soo qorayaa inaan dabagal ku sameeyo iimaylkaygii hore.” Ku dhammee tallaabada xigta oo cad iyo “Kind regards”.
examplesSo: Iyadoo la tixraacayo...: waxaa lagu xusaa arrin hore u dhacday.
Xusuusin: wax qofka ka caawiya inuu xasuusto arrin.
Tallaabada xigta: hawsha xigta ee ay tahay in la qabto.
